output.summary: Incidents rise mainly because deferred reliability work (open, overdue postmortem actions) lets known failure modes recur, while interrupt load blocks fixes, a self-reinforcing loop. Volume growth is only 7% and EU carries 11% of volume with 3 of 25 incidents. The tool migration only inflated SEV3-SEV4 counts. Storage's ring-fence exemption cut its incidents and pages with traffic unchanged. Networking's second-slot pilot did not help and raised burden. Coverage is not the constraint. Attrition mixes pay and on-call, so the cause is unresolved. Prefer ring-fencing engineers to close recurring-incident fixes. Incident-count targets are harmful given the 2023 audit. A pay-only response is premature.
